trs.20: Woe to those who give less [than due],<sup foot_note=197725>1</sup>
trs.85: Woe to those who give short measure,
trs.22: Woe to those that deal in fraud,-
trs.203: Woe to Al-Mutaffifûn (those who give less in measure and weight).

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ

trs.20: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
trs.85: who demand of other people full measure for themselves,
trs.22: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, exact full measure,
trs.203: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, demand full measure,

trs.20: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
trs.85: but give less than they should when it is they who weigh or measure for others!
trs.22: But when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due.
trs.203: And when they have to give by measure or weight to (other) men, give less than due.

trs.20: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
trs.85: Do these people not realize that they will be raised up
trs.22: Do they not think that they will be called to account?-
trs.203: Do they not think that they will be resurrected (for reckoning),

trs.20: For a tremendous Day -
trs.85: on a mighty Day,
trs.22: On a Mighty Day,
trs.203: On a Great Day?

trs.20: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
trs.85: a Day when everyone will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
trs.22: A Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
trs.203: The Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)?

verses.text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ

trs.20: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
trs.85: No indeed! The list of the wicked is in Sijjin––
trs.22: Nay! Surely the record of the wicked is (preserved) in Sijjin.
trs.203: Nay! Truly, the Record (writing of the deeds) of the Fujjâr (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, evil-doers and the wicked) is (preserved) in Sijjîn.

trs.20: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
trs.85: what will explain to you what Sijjin is?––
trs.22: And what will explain to thee what Sijjin is?
trs.203: And what will make you know what Sijjîn is?

trs.20: It is [their destination<sup foot_note=197726>1</sup> recorded in] a register inscribed.
trs.85: a clearly numbered list.
trs.22: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed.
trs.203: A Register inscribed.

trs.20: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
trs.85: Woe on that day to the deniers,
trs.22: Woe, that Day, to those that deny-
trs.203: Woe, that Day, to those who deny.

trs.20: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
trs.85: those who deny the Day of Judgement!
trs.22: Those that deny the Day of Judgment.
trs.203: Those who deny the Day of Recompense.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

trs.20: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
trs.85: Only the evil aggressor denies it:
trs.22: And none can deny it but the Transgressor beyond bounds the Sinner!
trs.203: And none can deny it except every transgressor beyond bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and disobedience to Allâh) the sinner!

verses.text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

trs.20: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
trs.85: when Our revelations are recited to him, he says, ‘Ancient fables!’
trs.22: When Our Signs are rehearsed to him, he says, "Tales of the ancients!"
trs.203: When Our Verses (of the Qur’ân) are recited to him he says: "Tales of the ancients!"

verses.text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

trs.20: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.<sup foot_note=197727>1</sup>
trs.85: No indeed! Their hearts are encrusted with what they have done.
trs.22: By no means! but on their hearts is the stain of the (ill) which they do!
trs.203: Nay! But on their hearts is the Rân (covering of sins and evil deeds) which they used to earn.<sup foot_note=155037>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ

trs.20: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.<sup foot_note=197728>1</sup>
trs.85: No indeed! On that Day they will be screened off from their Lord,
trs.22: Verily, from (the Light of) their Lord, that Day, will they be veiled.
trs.203: Nay! Surely they (evil-doers) will be veiled from seeing their Lord that Day.

trs.20: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
trs.85: they will burn in Hell,
trs.22: Further, they will enter the Fire of Hell.
trs.203: Then, verily, they will indeed enter (and taste) the burning flame of Hell.

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

trs.20: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
trs.85: and they will be told, ‘This is what you called a lie.’
trs.22: Further, it will be said to them: "This is the (reality) which ye rejected as false!
trs.203: Then, it will be said to them: "This is what you used to deny!"

verses.text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ

trs.20: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.
trs.85: No indeed! The list of the truly good is in 'Illiyyin––
trs.22: Nay, verily the record of the Righteous is (preserved) in 'Illiyin.
trs.203: Nay! Verily, the Record (writing of the deeds) of Al-Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism) is (preserved) in ‘Illiyyûn

trs.20: And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?
trs.85: what will explain to you what 'Illiyyin is?––
trs.22: And what will explain to thee what 'Illiyun is?
trs.203: And what will make you know what ‘Illiyyûn is?

trs.20: It is [their destination<sup foot_note=197729>1</sup> recorded in] a register inscribed
trs.85: a clearly written list,
trs.22: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed,
trs.203: A Register inscribed,

trs.20: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allāh].
trs.85: witnessed by those brought near.
trs.22: To which bear witness those Nearest (to Allah).
trs.203: To which bear witness those nearest (to Allâh, i.e. the angels).

trs.20: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
trs.85: The truly good will live in bliss,
trs.22: Truly the Righteous will be in Bliss:
trs.203: Verily, Al-Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism) will be in Delight (Paradise).

trs.20: On adorned couches, observing.
trs.85: seated on couches, gazing around.
trs.22: On Thrones (of Dignity) will they command a sight (of all things):
trs.203: On thrones, looking (at all things).

trs.20: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
trs.85: You will recognize on their faces the radiance of bliss.
trs.22: Thou wilt recognise in their faces the beaming brightness of Bliss.
trs.203: You will recognise in their faces the brightness of delight.

trs.20: They will be given to drink [pure] wine<sup foot_note=197730>1</sup> [which was] sealed.
trs.85: They will be served a sealed nectar,
trs.22: Their thirst will be slaked with Pure Wine sealed:
trs.203: They will be given to drink of pure sealed wine.

translation.text: They will be given to drink

verses.text_uthmani: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ

trs.20: The last of it<sup foot_note=197731>1</sup> is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
trs.85: its seal [perfumed with] a fragrant herb––let those who strive, strive for this––
trs.22: The seal thereof will be Musk: And for this let those aspire, who have aspirations:
trs.203: The last thereof (that wine) will be the smell of Musk, and for this let (all) those strive who want to strive (i.e. hasten earnestly to the obedience of Allah).

trs.20: And its mixture is of Tasneem,<sup foot_note=197732>1</sup>
trs.85: mixed with the water of Tasnim,
trs.22: With it will be (given) a mixture of Tasnim:
trs.203: It (that wine) will be mixed with Tasnîm:

trs.20: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.
trs.85: a spring from which those brought near will drink.
trs.22: A spring, from (the waters) whereof drink those Nearest to Allah.
trs.203: A spring whereof drink those nearest to Allâh.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ

trs.20: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
trs.85: The wicked used to laugh at the believers––
trs.22: Those in sin used to laugh at those who believed,
trs.203: Verily, (during the worldly life) those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

trs.20: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
trs.85: they would wink at one another when the believers passed by them,
trs.22: And whenever they passed by them, used to wink at each other (in mockery);
trs.203: And, whenever they passed by them, used to wink one to another (in mockery).

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ

trs.20: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
trs.85: joke about them when they got back to their own people,
trs.22: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;
trs.203: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ

trs.20: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
trs.85: and say, when they saw them, ‘These people are misguided,’
trs.22: And whenever they saw them, they would say, "Behold! These are the people truly astray!"
trs.203: And when they saw them, they said: "Verily these have indeed gone astray!"

trs.20: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
trs.85: though they were not sent to be their keepers-
trs.22: But they had not been sent as keepers over them!
trs.203: But they (disbelievers, sinners) had not been sent as watchers over them (the believers).

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ

trs.20: So Today<sup foot_note=197733>1</sup> those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
trs.85: so today the believers are laughing at the disbelievers
trs.22: But on this Day the Believers will laugh at the Unbelievers:
trs.203: But this Day (the Day of Resurrection) those who believe will laugh at the disbelievers<sup foot_note=155038>1</sup>

trs.20: On adorned couches, observing.
trs.85: as they sit on couches, gazing around.
trs.22: On Thrones (of Dignity) they will command (a sight) (of all things).
trs.203: On (high) thrones, looking (at all things).

verses.text_uthmani: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ

trs.20: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
trs.85: Have the disbelievers [not] been repaid for their deeds?
trs.22: Will not the Unbelievers have been paid back for what they did?
trs.203: Are not the disbelievers paid (fully) for what they used to do?
